text:
elaine: Need an access-control evidence bundle for FinReg follow-up. They want: SAML->RBAC sample, service-account rotation note, session TTLs, and one audit row proving MFA=true. EOD ask.

samir: I got SAML + MFA. Short summary: we accept SAML 2.0/OIDC, map attributes into RBAC (email/groups/entitlements) and persist authn_context and mfa flags in audit events. Hosted: tenant controls can require MFA for admins.

samir: Sample SAML AttributeStatement (paste):

<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="email"><AttributeValue>${user.email}</AttributeValue>
  <Attribute Name="groups"><AttributeValue>${user.groups}</AttributeValue>
  <Attribute Name="entitlements"><AttributeValue>redwood:deployer</AttributeValue>
</AttributeStatement>

morgan: RBAC YAML snippet to show least privilege (minimal):

roles:
  - id: reader
    permissions: [models.read, logs.read]
service_accounts:
  - id: poc-sa
    scopes: [models.read]
    token_ttl_seconds: 3600
    allow_pattern: "/v1/models/poc-*"

samir: To pull an MFA audit row (org-admin):

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://console.redwood/api/v1/audit?filter=event:authentication.success AND mfa:true&limit=1"

infra-bot: audit-export ready: /exports/finreg/mfa_row_1840000000.csv (presigned link valid 48h)

morgan: Rotation + revoke blurb for SIG: "Service account credentials are short-lived tokens or mTLS certs signed by KMS-managed keys. Ephemeral keys rotate nightly; root keys rotate weekly. Revocation is immediate via the revocation API and all rotation/revoke operations are logged in the audit trail."

elaine: Perfect. Can we also note session defaults?

jordan: (cc) defaults: console idle timeout 45m, interactive session 60m, API token TTL 900s (refresh allowed).

elaine: Good. Morgan please assemble ZIP (SAML XML, RBAC YAML, audit CSV link, screenshot) and drop link. We'll review then send to FinReg.
